Tutorials help, no need panic.","According to you, how can LLMs be used to innovate math learning in schools and universities?":"LLMs like GPT can personalize math tutoring: adaptive problems, step-by-step hints without judgment—great for anxious kids like me. My openness loves it, counters low con by instant feedback. Ethical: teacher oversight."},"reasoning_summary":"Responses reflect a 19yo introverted, highly neurotic, low-conscientious immigrant with high openness: anxious/inaccurate math views, casual imperfect explanations, enthusiasm for AI, hobbies/school woven in, first-person human style."}
